option.heavyinventories.weight_measure.t: Display units only: stored weights are pounds; kilograms convert by 0.45359237. None shows raw values. Capacity and gameplay are unchanged.
option.heavyinventories.walking_mode.too: Progressive slows walking as weight increases. The 90% mode keeps full speed until 90%, then decreases to zero at capacity. Surefooted applies in both modes.
option.heavyinventories.starting_max_wei: Base capacity in stored pounds, before Strength and equipment bonuses.
option.heavyinventories.normal_text_colo: The standard text color for the GUI.
option.heavyinventories.encumbered_text_: The text color for encumbered GUI.
option.heavyinventories.over_encumbered_: The text color for over encumbered GUI.
tooltip.heavyinventories.calculation_lim: Contents exceed the weight calculation limit; treated as over capacity.
config.heavyinventories.denied: Only server operators can change server settings.
config.heavyinventories.stale: Server settings changed while this screen was open. Reopen it and try again.
config.heavyinventories.saved: Server settings saved. The change applies to all players.
config.heavyinventories.reloaded: Reloaded server settings and rebuilt weights from loaded datapacks and recipes. Use /reload to load edited datapack files.
config.heavyinventories.weights_reload_f: Heavy Inventories could not apply reloaded weights; previous weights remain active. %s
config.heavyinventories.unavailable: Join a Heavy Inventories server to view its settings.
config.heavyinventories.edit_help: Saving sends your changes to the server. Operator permission is checked there; accepted changes apply to all players.
config.heavyinventories.read_only: These are the server's settings. Only server operators can change them.
command.heavyinventories.players_reloade: Player weights will refresh on the next tick.
command.heavyinventories.config.invalid: Unknown config: %s. Use client, server, or common.
command.heavyinventories.config.no_playe: Open a config screen from a player.
command.heavyinventories.exported: Exported weight report to %s, including sources. This is not an installable datapack and does not change gameplay.
command.heavyinventories.converted: Converted %s weights (%s entries without weights skipped) to %s. Review the ZIP, install it in the intended world's datapacks folder, and enable it. Source files and gameplay were unchanged.
option.heavyinventories.ring_vertical_of: Moves the ring and XP number upward together in GUI pixels (0–64; default 7). Zero may overlap the XP bar. Try 12 for long XP numbers. Hiding the ring restores vanilla XP positioning.
config.heavyinventories.effects_pending: These settings are saved but are not active in this build yet.
config.heavyinventories.knockback_active: Adds temporary knockback resistance from actual carried weight. Stacks with equipment; does not add explosion resistance. Changes apply on the next server player tick.
config.heavyinventories.fluid_active: Controls horizontal swimming, sinking, and optional upward propulsion denial. Water and lava can be selected separately; currents and bubble propulsion remain intact.
chat.heavyinventories.no_swim_up: You are carrying too much weight to swim upward.
config.heavyinventories.fall_active: Increases fall damage gradually with carried weight. Safe falls, landing blocks and normal protections still apply.
config.heavyinventories.exhaustion_activ: Adds hunger exhaustion for voluntary movement and jumping, scaled by weight and walking mode. No extra idle drain.
option.heavyinventories.effects.fluids.w: Apply swimming, sinking and upward-movement restrictions in water.
option.heavyinventories.effects.fluids.l: Apply swimming, sinking and upward-movement restrictions in lava.
option.heavyinventories.effects.exhausti: Increase the cost of voluntary walking, sprinting, swimming and jumping. No additional idle drain.
1 to 100. Scales existing qualifying exhaustion with the walking mode, before Surefooted. Reaches maximum at full capacity.
0 to 100. Extra cost per block of voluntary ordinary walking at full capacity; lower loads scale with walking mode.
option.heavyinventories.effects.fallDama: Apply a configurable multiplier while preserving normal fall protection.
1 to 100. Caps the added fall penalty; 1 adds no penalty.
option.heavyinventories.effects.swimming: Scale horizontal movement in enabled fluids while preserving other movement modifiers.
0 to 1. At full penalty: 0.5 means half the otherwise applicable horizontal movement.
Scale gravity in enabled fluids; does not cancel currents or bubble-column motion.
1 to 100. At full penalty: 2 means twice the normal fluid gravity.
option.heavyinventories.effects.upwardMo: Prevent player-driven ascent at the threshold, including jumping out of the fluid. External upward motion is preserved.
0 to 10000 percent of effective capacity, including Strength and equipment bonuses. Default: 100.
option.heavyinventories.effects.knockbac: Add temporary resistance based on actual carried pounds, independently of carrying-capacity bonuses.
Greater than zero, at most 1000000000 stored pounds. Resistance scales linearly up to this weight.
0 to 1. HI adds at most this amount without replacing resistance from equipment or other mods.
option.heavyinventories.effects.fallDama: 0 to 10000 percent of effective capacity. Must be below the full-penalty threshold.
0 to 10000 percent of effective capacity. Must be above the onset threshold; the penalty is capped here.

0 to 10000 percent of effective capacity. Must be above the onset threshold; the penalty is capped here.
